title: Treat `.factory/agents/<role>/history.md` as factory run-state inside the existing clean-HEAD check, for any single role directory. Do not add `.factory/agents/` as a prefix, do not gitignore history files, and do not change the `git status --porcelain` invocation. Verify with `node --test test/agent-history-run-state.test.mjs` and `node --test test/approval-run-state.test.mjs`.
acceptanceCriteria: History files stay on the current HEAD, and approval run-state behavior stays as it is.
